title: Space radiation
text: Beyond low Earth orbit crews face galactic cosmic rays and solar particle events with no practical shielding on the body.
The mission keeps each astronaut's cumulative dose against the 600 mSv career limit in NASA-STD-3001; solar storms trigger shelter procedures.
Report unusual dosimeter readings to mission control and log shelter time.

citations.source: NASA Human Research Program: the five hazards of human spaceflight — radiation.
NASA-STD-3001 Vol. 1 Rev. B: crew radiation limits.
